svg.title: Loop-de-Loop
svg.desc:
Loop-de-Loop inspired by Anna Weltman's book, This is Not a Maths Book.
Image creates a spirolateral type image for a given number sequence. Line segments are drawn 90 degrees in the counterclockwise direction on a 20x20 grid. Repeating patterns colored in red. Starting point (x,y) and number sequence can be passed to the image via a querystring appended to the url i.e. append to the SVG image url to draw that sequence. Default parameters are quivalent to the query string The timing can be changed by passing t=milliseconds (default=250 is minimum allowed).
Jay Nick steamcoded.org
